items.title: How do submarines know where they are?
items.author: Veritasium
items.content:
<article>How does a submarine find its way 600m deep in the ocean?

Surfacing is obviously the easiest way but not when you want to stay hidden.

So how do a crew balance concealment and pathfinding?</article>

items.title: The World's Heaviest Weight
items.author: Veritasium
items.content:
<article>How do you measure big forces accurately? 

By calibrating your force transducer on the world's biggest weight - 1,000,000 pounds of force. 

This machine ensures planes don't break apart, jets provide required thrust, and rockets make it to their destination.</article>

items.title: The Most Controversial Thought Experiment In Physics
items.author: Veritasium
items.content:
<article>Put a cat in a box with a radioactive atom. Add a radiation detector that triggers the release of poisonous cyanide gas.

Schrödinger's thought experiment was supposed to be a criticism of quantum mechanics and is now one of it's best explainers.

Here's why and what happens to the cat...</article>
